name: What is the R-value of insulation and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is the R-value of insulation and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: The R-value measures insulation's resistance to heat flow. A higher R-value indicates greater insulating power and better thermal performance. The appropriate R-value for your home depends on factors like your climate zone, the specific area being insulated (attic, walls, floor), and the type of heating and cooling system you have. Building codes in areas like Huntington Beach and Irvine typically specify minimum R-values to ensure energy efficiency and comfort in homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: R-value measures insulation's resistance to heat flow; a higher R-value means better thermal performance. It's crucial for energy efficiency and depends on climate and location within the home.
